crossRefs.note: Within the inner sanctuary was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in width, and twenty cubits in its height…
He made the most holy place. Its length, according to the width of the house, was twenty cubits, and its width twenty…
The city is square, and its length is as great as its width. He measured the city with the reed, twelve thousand twelve…
You shall hang up the veil under the clasps, and shall bring the ark of the covenant in there within the veil. The veil…
You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the covenant in the most holy place.
After the second veil was the tabernacle which is called the Holy of Holies,

parallels.note: The porch in front of the temple of the house had a length of twenty cubits, which was along the width of the house.…

people.name: Most_Holy_Place
people.line: The innermost room of the tabernacle and temple

translations.web: He measured its length, twenty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits, before the temple. He said to me, “This is the most holy place.”
translations.bsb: Then he measured the room adjacent to the inner sanctuary to be twenty cubits long and twenty cubits wide. And he said to me, “This is the Most Holy Place.”
translations.kjv: So he measured the length thereof, twenty cubits; and the breadth, twenty cubits, before the temple: and he said unto me, This is the most holy
translations.asv: And he measured the length thereof, twenty cubits, and the breadth, twenty cubits, before the temple: and he said unto me, This is the most holy place.
